sections.heading: A clear blueprint for your Global Capability Centre
sections.body:
A Global Capability Centre (GCC) brings dedicated capability into your organisation’s delivery model. The right strategy starts with the business outcomes, the work the centre will own and the way it will connect with your existing teams.

Linkfields provides operating model and set-up advisory to translate those choices into a practical roadmap. Our wider delivery footprint includes an offshore delivery centre in Hyderabad, India, and 5+ data & development centres.
